headline: Drone strike in Kuwait kills two Italians; EU budget summit collapses; storms snarl US Thanksgiving

us.headline: Storms batter much of the U.S. over Thanksgiving
us.summary: Heavy rain, 50-plus mph gusts and flooding hit the East Coast, New Jersey declared a state of emergency, the Chesapeake Bay Bridge-Tunnel closed for hours and up to 13 inches of snow was forecast near St. Louis.

us.headline: Trump calls revised GDP figures 'fake' and seeks Commerce probe
us.summary: Trump accused the Bureau of Economic Analysis of deliberately publishing wrong third-quarter figures before the midterms after growth was revised up to a 4.3% annual rate; the same release showed PCE inflation climbing to 3.8% in October.

us.headline: Trump says Iran war will end when he decides
us.summary: The president said the conflict with Iran would be over essentially whenever he wants it to be.

us.headline: Black Friday shopping opens amid inflation worries
us.summary: Retailers expect heavy Black Friday spending as shoppers hunt for value deals after a stormy holiday week.

australia.headline: National gas reservation scheme clears the Senate
australia.summary: The scheme passed the Senate in a late sitting and awaited a final House vote on the last sitting day of the year, with Western Australia carved out because it has run its own reservation policy since 2006.

australia.headline: Victorian Coalition costings lean on asset sales and a hiring freeze
australia.summary: Parliamentary Budget Office figures released on the eve of Saturday's vote show a 90-year sewerage lease and other sales saving $13.8 billion, a public service hiring freeze saving $3.8 billion and level crossing removals scrapped.

australia.headline: One Nation vows to oppose Coalition's sewerage privatisation
australia.summary: With more than 2.2 million Victorians already voted, One Nation said it would fight the proposed sewerage lease, while ABC analysis rates a Coalition win likely but a majority uncertain.

australia.headline: Unofficial lobby groups outspend Victorian Labor on social ads
australia.summary: Better Victoria and FixVictoria together spent more on Meta ads than Labor's official account since late August, while a disclosure loophole keeps their funders hidden.

australia.headline: Senate committee urges review of aged care co-payments
australia.summary: A committee report on the aged care overhaul recommended reviewing Support at Home co-payments and changing the law so clinicians can override assessment algorithms.

ai.headline: ACCC warns shoppers about AI agents in Black Friday sales
ai.summary: The consumer watchdog advised Australians to check AI shopping answers against other sources and to set spending limits on AI agents allowed to buy on their behalf.

ai.headline: Denny's restores plaque honoring returning Nvidia CEO Huang
ai.summary: The restaurant chain put back a plaque honoring Jensen Huang to mark his return as Nvidia's chief executive.

tech.headline: Germany and Austria push for European ownership of TikTok
tech.summary: Two ministers called for TikTok's European business and recommendation algorithm to come under European control and plan to raise it at an EU council meeting on Dec. 2; TikTok said the idea has no merit.

tech.headline: Denmark arrests teen over civil registry breach
tech.summary: An 18-year-old was remanded in custody, accused of pulling 11,000 identification numbers from Denmark's civil registration system in a breach caught by monitoring added after an October attack.

tech.headline: SpaceX to donate stock to children with Trump accounts
tech.summary: Elon Musk pledged SpaceX shares to American children who have active Trump accounts.

world.headline: Iran denies drone strike in Kuwait that killed two Italians
world.summary: Italy says Iranian drones hit Kuwaiti military sites including a radar centre where two Italian contractors died; Gulf states condemned the attack while Tehran called the accusation baseless and offered a joint inquiry.

world.headline: EU budget summit ends without a deal
world.summary: Leaders rejected a €1.78 trillion seven-year compromise from all sides, cancelled Friday's talks and barely discussed the €45 billion Ukraine loan, with Macron setting a Dec. 31 deadline.

world.headline: NATO jets scrambled as drone enters Latvian airspace
world.summary: An unidentified drone briefly flew over Ludza municipality near the Russian border overnight, and Latvia's military warned more incursions are likely.

world.headline: Congo's Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases
world.summary: The outbreak has passed 12,000 cases as some responders are evacuated.

world.headline: Spain's Hernández de Cos nominated to lead the ECB
world.summary: Pablo Hernández de Cos was put forward to succeed Christine Lagarde when she steps down on Feb. 7, pending final approval by EU leaders in December.

world.headline: French inflation slows to 2.9% as energy prices ease
world.summary: Prices fell 0.7% in November, bringing annual inflation down to 2.9%, while official data showed GDP shrank 0.2% in the third quarter.

aus-cricket.headline: Overton's 5-12 routs Australia at the Gabba as England lead 2-1
aus-cricket.summary: Australia were bowled out for 108, their lowest home T20I total, and England chased a rain-revised 93 to win by seven wickets on DLS.

aus-cricket.headline: Stanlake returns for first T20I in seven years
aus-cricket.summary: Billy Stanlake and Mitch Owen came in for Jack Edwards and Lachlan Shaw, with Spencer Johnson out with a calf niggle; the series moves to the SCG on Sunday and Canberra on Wednesday.

aus-cricket.headline: Tasmania hold on for Shield draw as Bird sets record
aus-cricket.summary: WA finished five runs short of a 142-run chase in 13 overs in Perth, and Jackson Bird's 442nd wicket made him the Shield's most successful fast bowler; Jhye Richardson left the field in discomfort.

warriors.headline: Warriors at Trail Blazers tonight in final NBA Cup group game
warriors.summary: Golden State (10-8) visits Portland at 6:30 p.m. Pacific at the Moda Center, with Stephen Curry (abdomen), Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody listed out.

warriors.headline: Lillard and Morant headline revamped Portland
warriors.summary: The Blazers added a returning Damian Lillard and traded for Ja Morant, who is nursing a hamstring strain, ahead of the Cup finale.
